type Request struct
  Op string
  Name string
  Rights []string
  Secret string
  Token string
  Right string
  Why string
  App string
  Admin string
type AppMetadata struct
  ID string
  Name string
  Rights []string
  Registered string
type HoldMetadata struct
  App string
  Name string
  Right string
  Why string
  Since string
type ResponseMetadata struct
  Code string
  Error string
  Secret string
  Token string
  Expires string
  App *AppMetadata
  Right string
  Apps []AppMetadata
  Holds []HoldMetadata
type Subject struct
  Account string
  Program string
type Decision struct
  Outcome DecisionOutcome
  PolicyRevision string
type PolicyRule struct
  Subject Subject
  Action string
  Resource string
  Permit bool
type PolicyPage struct
  Outcome PolicyPageOutcome
  Revision string
  Catalog []string
  Rules []PolicyRule
  Next string
  Complete bool
type PolicyEdit struct
  Outcome PolicyEditOutcome
  Revision string
  Current *PolicyRule
type RuleRecord struct
  Rule PolicyRule
  SetBy Subject
  SetAt string
  Why string
  Expires string
type RuleRead struct
  Outcome RuleReadOutcome
  Revision string
  Record *RuleRecord
type CatalogEntry struct
  Action string
  RegisteredBy Subject
  RegisteredAt string
type ActionDescription struct
  Action string
  FeatureApp Subject
  AppLabel string
  Description string
  DeclaredRisk string
type PermissionDefinition struct
  Action string
  OwnerContract string
  Operations []string
  ResourceProfile string
  ResourceType string
  EnforcedBy []string
  Disclosure string
  Lifecycle string
  FirstUse PermissionFirstUse
  Served bool
type DescribedAction struct
  Action string
  Choices []string
  Description *ActionDescription
  PublishedBy *Subject
  PublishedAt string
type ActionEdit struct
  Outcome ActionEditOutcome
  Revision string
  Current *CatalogEntry
type DescriptionEdit struct
  Outcome ActionEditOutcome
  Revision string
  Current *DescribedAction
type DescriptionPage struct
  Outcome PolicyPageOutcome
  Revision string
  Actions []DescribedAction
  Next string
  Complete bool
type AccountDefault struct
  Name string
  Action string
  Resource string
  EveryResource bool
  On bool
  SetBy *Subject
  SetAt string
type DefaultPage struct
  Outcome PolicyPageOutcome
  Revision string
  Defaults []AccountDefault
type DefaultEdit struct
  Outcome PolicyEditOutcome
  Revision string
  Current *AccountDefault
type DecisionExplanation struct
  Outcome DecisionOutcome

  DefaultName string
type PermissionKey struct
  Action string
  ResourceProfile string
type ResourceSelector struct
  Kind ResourceSelectorKind
  Target []byte
type PermissionSelection struct
  Permission PermissionKey
  Selector ResourceSelector
type ConcreteResource struct
  Permission PermissionKey
  Target []byte
type CheckBatchRequest struct
  ExpectedRevision string
  CollectionAdmission *PermissionKey
  Resources []ConcreteResource
type BatchDecision struct
  Outcome BatchCheckOutcome
  Revision string
  CollectionOutcome *DecisionOutcome
  Outcomes []DecisionOutcome
type SelectorPermissionDefinition struct
  Definition PermissionDefinition
  Label string
  SupportedSelectors []ResourceSelectorKind
  FirstUseSelectors []ResourceSelectorKind
  Collection string
  AllEffect string
  RequestType string

  Complete bool

  Complete bool

  BundleRef string

  Selection PermissionSelection

const EndpointContract

type Authorization interface
  ListActionDescriptions(cursor string, limit int64) (DescriptionPage, error)
  Decide(action, resource string) (Decision, error)
  DecideFor(subject Subject, action, resource string) (Decision, error)
type AuthorizationTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type AuthorizationClient struct
func NewAuthorizationClient(t AuthorizationTransport) *AuthorizationClient
type AuthorizationDispatcher struct
  Handler Authorization
func (AuthorizationClient) ListActionDescriptions(cursor string, limit int64) (result DescriptionPage, err error)
func (AuthorizationClient) Decide(action, resource string) (result Decision, err error)
func (AuthorizationClient) DecideFor(subject Subject, action, resource string) (result Decision, err error)
func (AuthorizationDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (AuthorizationDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (AuthorizationDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (AuthorizationDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (AuthorizationDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type AuthorizationOperator interface
  RegisterDescribedAction(expectedRevision string, description ActionDescription) (DescriptionEdit, error)
  ApplyFirstUseAllow(expectedRevision, questionID string) (PolicyEdit, error)
  ListPolicy(cursor string, limit int64) (PolicyPage, error)
  SetRule(expectedRevision string, rule PolicyRule) (PolicyEdit, error)
  RevokeRule(expectedRevision string, subject Subject, action, resource string) (PolicyEdit, error)
  StopAnswerer(expectedRevision string, answerer Subject, alsoRevokeGrants bool) (PolicyEdit, error)
  RevokeAnswerPermits(expectedRevision string, answerer, target Subject, actions []string, resource, questionID string) (PolicyEdit, error)
  SetRuleFor(expectedRevision string, rule PolicyRule, ttlMs int64, why string) (PolicyEdit, error)
  SetRulesFor(expectedRevision string, rules []PolicyRule, ttlMs int64, why string) (PolicyEdit, error)
  ReadRule(subject Subject, action, resource string) (RuleRead, error)
  RegisterAction(expectedRevision, action string) (ActionEdit, error)
  RetireAction(expectedRevision, action string) (ActionEdit, error)
  ExplainFor(subject Subject, action, resource string) (DecisionExplanation, error)
  ListDefaults() (DefaultPage, error)
  SetDefault(expectedRevision, name string, on bool) (DefaultEdit, error)
type AuthorizationOperatorTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type AuthorizationOperatorClient struct
func NewAuthorizationOperatorClient(t AuthorizationOperatorTransport) *AuthorizationOperatorClient
type AuthorizationOperatorDispatcher struct
  Handler AuthorizationOperator
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) RegisterDescribedAction(expectedRevision string, description ActionDescription) (result DescriptionEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) ApplyFirstUseAllow(expectedRevision, questionID string) (result PolicyEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) ListPolicy(cursor string, limit int64) (result PolicyPage, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) SetRule(expectedRevision string, rule PolicyRule) (result PolicyEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) RevokeRule(expectedRevision string, subject Subject, action, resource string) (result PolicyEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) StopAnswerer(expectedRevision string, answerer Subject, alsoRevokeGrants bool) (result PolicyEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) RevokeAnswerPermits(expectedRevision string, answerer, target Subject, actions []string, resource, questionID string) (result PolicyEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) SetRuleFor(expectedRevision string, rule PolicyRule, ttlMs int64, why string) (result PolicyEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) SetRulesFor(expectedRevision string, rules []PolicyRule, ttlMs int64, why string) (result PolicyEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) ReadRule(subject Subject, action, resource string) (result RuleRead, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) RegisterAction(expectedRevision, action string) (result ActionEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) RetireAction(expectedRevision, action string) (result ActionEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) ExplainFor(subject Subject, action, resource string) (result DecisionExplanation, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) ListDefaults() (result DefaultPage, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorClient) SetDefault(expectedRevision, name string, on bool) (result DefaultEdit, err error)
func (AuthorizationOperatorDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (AuthorizationOperatorDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (AuthorizationOperatorDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
